title: Long-Term Change (Father-Focused)
description: This course supports fathers to build sustainable behaviour change that strengthens child safety, emotional stability, and family wellbeing.
learningOutcomes: Understand long-term change in the context of fatherhood.
Recognise barriers that disrupt safe parenting.
Learn strategies for maintaining safe behaviour.
Develop habits that support long-term family safety.

modules.title: Fathering and Change
modules.content: Explores how consistent behaviour supports children’s development.

modules.title: Sustaining Safe Behaviour
modules.content: Provides tools for long-term behavioural stability.
